ns2:section.sectionText: Reserved for incoming freshmen only. If you have questions about your qualifications for this program please go to http://www.las.uiuc.edu/learningcommunity/ Advisory approval from summer orientation should contact the LAS Advising office. ANTHROPOLOGY 103 GL AND LC ARE FOR FRESHMEN ONLY IN THE FALL SEMESTERS. IF YOU ARE NOT A FRESHMEN YOU MAY TAKE IT IN THE SPRING SEMESTERS. IF YOU ARE A SENIOR MAJOR IN ANTHROPOLOGY, PLEASE CONTACT THE ANTHROPOLOGY OFFICE AT 333-3616.
